reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: any travel journey begins from the flight, some bag packers choose the cheapest option which is fine as your expectations are set accordingly however I was travelling with a 1 year old child. We chose Jet airways over Sri Lankan airlines as Jet airways slightly expensive and we thought the service would be better, to our disappointment the flight was nothing less than a cramped bus. I had to squeeze in and our legs were numb by the time we arrived. I needed hot water to make my child's milk and I kept asking the attendant who paid no attention, this pissed me off and I raised my voice and asked her to bring it right away. It is ridiculous how arrogant these people can be even towards a little child. My experience was not very good..
reviews.author: Madyna

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: I had always loved the service of Jet airways as they were a class apart, I always preferred to fly by Jet airways but was very sad when I heard that the airlines has stopped his operation, was really a very bad news for lots of travellers like me.

reviews.title: A BUNCH OF LIARS
reviews.text: After having been promised a full refund-- from the Mississauga office rep-- then it was all excuses-- like your refund will be processed after this date. It was on going. Why not tell the passengers-- we are broke-- so no refund-- you money is gone. This was a reputable airline but now I think it's the worst I've dealt with & they are a bunch of liars.

reviews.author: Sondra

reviews.title: Extra charge to sit apart on wedding anniversary
reviews.text: On our Golden Wedding anniversary we were returning for the first time to my wife's place of birth. We never fly First Class, but I accepted the very expensive upgrade offer at check-in as it was a unique and emotional time for my wife. I was horrified to find we had been charged several times the economy fare to sit apart. So much for the romance! Jet Airways refused to consider any refund whatsoever - and we felt cheated.
reviews.author: Laemmergeier172

reviews.title: Refund refusal for flight cancelled at short notice
reviews.text: Our return flight was cancelled about an hour before due departure. We have received part refund - less than 50% - and the airline refuse to refund the rest. Frankly disgusted.
reviews.author: Laemmergeier172

reviews.title: Flat bed business class
reviews.text: I travelled from Mumbai to Toronto via Amsterdam by flight numbers 232/234 on 27th March 2019. The service is excellent in business class. You get flat bed to rest with good entertainment options. Food served is excellent and the courtesy and services offered by staff to make your travel comfortable is excellent.

reviews.title: Jet airways were a good domestic airline and equally bad internationally
reviews.text: Domestic Experience: Great food, comfortable seats - in line with expectations especially with the competitive price International experience: Insect in food, had to throw it away. No USB charger in seats and smelly cabins. Terrible experience. The good thing about Jet was the JP Miles which can be used to buy a lot of interesting things on their reward store.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Departure flight was half empty and had the whole bench to myself. Staff is very nice. There was not a single seat left on my returning flight, leaving me stuck in a tiny middle seat. We got plenty of food but it was not very good. They offered free wine with the meal.
reviews.author: Marisa G

reviews.title: Good airline gone...
reviews.text: This was the only flight I've ever made with the Jet Airways. Although the said airline likely went into an irreversible oblivion due to its financial mismanagement, still, its in-flight service out of Toronto to Delhi, via Amsterdam, wasn't too bad. The flight attendants were courteous and most friendly, the evening meal rather simply presented but tasty, served beverages and wines agreeable too. The plane was very clean and the leg-room better when compared to Air Canada's squeezed seating, and so was the overall attention to ordinary Economy Class passangers.
reviews.author: ppcanada2015

reviews.title: Jet Airways cancelled flight
reviews.text: So disappointed that our flight home with Jet Airways was cancelled after a great holiday in India. Had a nightmare trying to get flight home. Had booked all flights through KLM who did try and get us in a Swiss Air flight but they refused us boarding as the flight was full. Got flight with Air India and then with KLM (Via Frankfurt and Amsterdam)at 3 times the cost and had to book extra night in Delhi and Frankfurt. Tried to get a refund but claim form in website doesn’t work. Did manage to speak to someone at Jet Airways but they would have nothing to do with us as we only had KLM booking reference and e-ticket numbers. KLM can’t give us Jet Airways numbers so at a loss as what to do. Credit card company trying to get us a refund but can’t see any way of getting compensation to cover the £1800 we have had to pay out as not covered by EU law. Insurance won’t pay as company not bankrupt yet. Anyone know what to do?
reviews.author: Phunter62

reviews.title: NEVER FLY JET EVEN IF THEY SURVIVE
reviews.text: JET cancelled 5 return flights for my family with no compensation and have not declared bancruptcy or liquidation thus preventing an insurance claim. We had to pay over £4,000 pounds for new flights or cancel my 60th birthday trip of a lifetime holiday. This airline, with hindsight, has a history of cancelling flights and leaving passengers stranded as no other airlines will accept patching as they don't pay. Phone lines not anwered or any communication. We chose Jet because of flight times not cost. BA was the same price.
reviews.author: Rachel C-G

reviews.title: we miss u jet airways
reviews.text: last time i travel on 3 rd april and on 17 april the airline shut it temporarily down. but to be honest we miss u jet airways and we miss our cheap fares which u provide for us.

reviews.title: Redemption of your Jpmiles
reviews.text: April 30th, 2019 it is 3 days that I'm trying to use my JPMiles but I just can't. because when you login into your account, the system tells you that your email has been verified, but your phone number is not verified. I've tried already 10 times in 3 days to receive the text message with the activation code, but they just don't send it to me. The system says that you will receive the message with the activation code, but this message never arrives. As long as I can't verify my mobile number I can't redeem my miles, so I can't make any reservation. so they are just locking me to do that. I've talked 4 times with the customer phone number and I've already written 3 emails. this is ridiculous. this is a shame of service and I have a feeling that they are doing that on purpose. Antonio Piretti

Not the best start to our Indian experience. I note this airline is no longer operating international flights - a saving grace in my opinion.

reviews.title: They appear to care about their passengers
reviews.text: They have the most comfortable seats in economy and the leg room is good for economy. Service is good and the snacks are tasty.
reviews.author: Robert K
reviews.route: New York City - West Palm Beach

reviews.title: Unbelieving challenging
reviews.text: I always hunted for cheapest fares possible from Ottawa to Delhi. I always find it on Expedia.ca. They usually fly on Air Canada operated Jet Airways. In 2017 I had a very bad experience with Jet. First they let us all in the plane and didn't fly for 6 hours. I was crouched in my seat for too long. I had injured my spinal tail bone so it was even more painful but I didn't disclose that to anyone. I requested the air hostess to let me go to the airport and come back an hour before the plane left but she said we couldn't leave the plane. Then they flew and stationed me for 2 days at Toronto airport en route. If you book your tickets through Expedia and not directly through the Airlines, they are not interested in you. Usually airlines overbook flights and chuck out the least preferable i.e those who do not book directly through them. I had a really difficult time. Air Canada assumed no responsibility. Jet Airways asked me to contact their kiosk at the airport. Jet Airways kiosk at the airport was not manned by their staff. They usually came one hour prior to the plane departure time and so I was unable to book the tickets until just before the plane was about to leave. Again they said the could not book me in the next day flight also. Not elaborating on details, my mother was in her last stage of blood cancer, I really wanted to go, Jet asked me to contact Expedia from whom I had initially booked. Their number was busy and the wait time was 3 hours. Nevertheless I kept holding the line for 3 hours from 1: 30 am to 3:40 am and just when the duration was about to finish, the customer service kiosk supervisor took the phone from me. I called again twice afterwards and had different wait times. Next night I was given hotel stay with $40 payment from my side. Upon arriving I found that my luggage had arrived 2 days prior. I looked for it and found several luggage bags unsupervised lying at a point. I found my suitcases but the used wheelchair I was taking for my mum was missing. They told me they would inform me when they found it. I filled the necessary forms. Then I got the used wheelchair broken so much as not be used at all. Jet compensated me after communicating with them over 50 times.
reviews.author: Preeti N

reviews.title: Need to Cancel my Ticket
reviews.text: I want to Cancel my tickets from Delhi to Bangkok the date is 27 April and 1 May. I just want to know what will be the charges of Flight cancellation? Please Help me out, Because i did not get any informative response from your Reservations Team.
reviews.author: Silvia Anderson

reviews.title: Local Culture Global Hospitality
reviews.text: My most favorite carrier since 2010. Whenever I traveled with Jet, got exceptional cordial support from them. Wish them all the luck to spread their wings soon.
reviews.author: Mohammed Kaikaus

reviews.title: A very pleasant surprise
reviews.text: We bought our tickets on a❔wave of scepticism. After all it's garish ads suggested a second rate airline with second rate planes and staff. How wrong could we be! The planes were new, immaculate and well finished. Onboard staff were attractive, well spoken and very helpful. Even announcements by the pilot were clear and concise. A great flight and on time. I was so impressed that I bought shares in the company. Contrast this with our return flight via Ryanair. A well worn plane,announcements from thick accented staff impossible to understand and the pilo's voice muffled. A good flight, though.
reviews.author: Nucleusman

reviews.title: Poor handling of Passengers in India
reviews.text: Truly annoying the manner this airline functioned..no alternate arrangements then and even for Intl airlines; approach is as if they wont fly again ...Intl flights ahead with jet which also got cancelled 15 days before leaving us to pay astronomical prices; no alternate arrangements; this can happen only in India where the Govt nor the airlines cares for its passengers; people are last to care for them.

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: This was the second time that i flew with them, wow I wished they would fly overseas to Europe. So much leg space, such a comfortable chair. Pleasant flight attendants.

reviews.title: The worst airline I've never flown with
reviews.text: Flight cancelled,no notice for over 3 weeks,their computer generated e mail contains a link to claim for a refund but it conveniently doesn't work. They don't reply to e mails.Phoning them is a waste of time and money. I will have to try and get a refund through my credit card company. As I write this review they have suspended all services,hopefully they will go out of business and save countless people from ever having to deal with them agian.

reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.text: I supposed to flight to Bangkok tomorrow and only this morning I received a text to say that the flight was cancelled,no reason given,no support,no help.We couldn't get in touch with them as they didn't answer the phone even though they left me on line for more than 2hours. We tried all day,in the end I had to book a new flight and I had to pay 700 pound only one way. I was shocked about this and at least they could respond and give advice after this unacceptable behavior. someone had the same problem?what about the refund,I demand the sum in full obviously. Never never again.

reviews.text: They changed my flight 3 times and the last time was only 7 hours before flying. Well, since they are now bankrupt, I don't have to fly with them anymore...

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: Going out was not a pleasant trip, staff moody. Never asked if we would like tea/coffee after the food.(so didn't get any). If you wanted anything new headsets had to ask numerus times before you got anything. Better trip back much pleasanter staff. But food was not the best. Hopefully wont be using this airline again.

reviews.title: Nice Flight
reviews.text: The flight had a lot of leg room which made this flight very enjoyable. I also like the TVs in the back of the seats. But the food was overpriced and not very good.
reviews.author: Iris L

reviews.title: Awasome
reviews.text: I love this airline.The staff is very nice and friendly.the food was good and the way they manage customer's problems is good.
reviews.author: rubi g

reviews.title: Average experience over 20 years
reviews.text: Been flying Jet since the beginning. The food quality kept dropping drastically over the years till the last one where even food was stale and raw. Their on-time improved but I think that was more to do with the fact that they adjusted the schedules.
reviews.author: Shangs v

reviews.title: So so travel
reviews.text: In order for my husband and I to sit together we had to upgrade to “even more room” which of course is great for leg room. But still narrow seats that fit a model or marathon runner perfectly( like any other airline) so to sit together round trip it cost $220 more. The seats seemed to be falling apart. The Velcro on seat covers was stretched tight but showed where old tape had been. Also some passengers around us had no sound from the armrest ear bud hookup. On our way back when I sat in my seat the armrest I front of me was upright and facing me. The whole top plate was hanging with wires attached and there was a water bottle left from the last flight. Apparently the flight attendants don’t clean in between flights.
reviews.author: Sara C

reviews.title: Jet, The best Airways
reviews.text: I have fly form Kathmandu to Pune via Delhi, best airways, nice cabin crews, good services. full recommendation !! But suprisly heard that, Jet airways cancell all international flight, might be management issued. wish them to recover soon !!
reviews.author: Ghanshyam Sharma

reviews.title: This airline is not recommended.
reviews.text: This was the 1st time we flew Jet Airways to Singapore. Previously, we used Singapore Airlines. This Jet flight was a 5 1/2 hour international flight, but there was no TV screen for the passengers, which we found quite odd. Before TVs were introduced on international flights, there used to be an audio device for listening to music on a number of channels. Even this was not provided. Our flight back to Mumbai on 23rd April has been cancelled, due to their financial problems. We have to make our own arrangements. The airline has not informed us anything on our email, including what amount will be refunded for this cancellation. We had booked our tickets through a travel agent.
reviews.author: Postwalla

reviews.title: Full of Hassles experience!
reviews.text: We were supposed to travel to Delhi on vacation but somehow our flight got rescheduled. We had to board at 4 am and there was no assistance on the airport at 12 for us to collect our rescheduled tickets. Pathetic service and customer experience. Not worth the journey!
reviews.author: Dhwani Sangani

reviews.title: Flight cancellation at last minute
reviews.text: My flight was cancelled during the last minute and i had to go through the travel agent to call the airline and instead of a direct, they gave me a transit and it caused me a lot of inconvenience because i had another flight to catch on the same day. The flight did not have in-flight entertainment, the food was terrible and the seats very narrow. I do not wish to travel using this airline again.
reviews.author: Jamie L
